metadata.title: Clicked like a confused squirrel and somehow got that 1 kill? Valorant’s aim is on vacation
metadata.description:
Me: wildly guessing where the enemy is
Enemy: probably uninstalling mid-shock
How did I surprise even myself? No clue, but I’m cashing in!
Click if your aim ever clocks out but still scores!

Tap if your aim ever took a day off but still got the kill!

#valorant #gamingfails #luckykill #funnygaming #shorts
